'''Birch''' is a [[tree]] found in temperate broadleaf forests. Birch trees have the special quality of being the only normal tree in the game with a trunk color other than brown – specifically, white. Unfortunately, the logs that they produce are still brown (burnt umber, as described in the raws). They are the second [[Highwood|tallest tree]] in the game.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] birches for their ''catkins'', ''silver bark'', and ''autumn coloration''.
